newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur details new CEO appointment.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur details new CEO appointment.

text.p: Winterthur Insurance Co said Thomas Wellauer, whom it earlier named as successor to chief executive Peter Spaelti, would take up his new post from January 1, 1998.

It said the succession was part of Spaelti's already announced intention to step down as chief executive officer and concentrate fully on his other post as chairman of the board, which he has held simultaneously since 1989.

A Winterthur statement said Wellauer, aged 42, was well acquainted with the insurer through his work as a director at the Zurich offices of international management consulting group McKinsey & Co Inc.

Wellauer was currently in charge of the Swiss financial services unit at McKinsey and had headed a large number of projects in multinational services as well as industry since joining McKinsey in 1986, Winterthur said.

"Since 1992, he has been involved in many of Winterthur's important strategic projects which means that he has already had an excellent insight into Winterthur and its organisation," the statement said.
"During various lengthy stays abroad, he has also worked in New York and Tokyo," it said.
It added that Wellauer had been appointed to his new post by Winterthur's board of directors.
